items.title: 67848_Jimmy McPartland oral history interview
items.q: And the trombone player is Lou McGarity. ... Now was that your own band?

ctx.x: In a day when it's very, very popular to talk about highs, different kinds of highs, I'm going to have to say that that was a real high. And the only way to go from there is further up. (LAUGHTER). Now Jimmy you want to talk perhaps a little bit about the other fellows who were on that recording with you?

Oh, the clarinetist was, Peanuts Hucko the clarinet player I should say is Peter (Taco?). And the trombone player is Lou McGarity. And George Wettling is on drums and on down the line, so on and so forth. Do you want to go through all that?
Now was that your own band?
